Product:{\"sku\":\"7100139544\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Two polarities. One way through.

Polarity War is a vertical bullet-hell shooter built around one idea: bullets of your own color fuel you, bullets of the other color destroy you. Switch polarity in an instant to soak up a wall of fire, then dodge the next one.

Every bullet you absorb fills your Flux gauge. When it is full, unleash Break to wipe the screen clear and turn the fight around. Chain kills for a higher score, collect power gems to Overcharge your guns, and watch for swirling shots that no color can absorb.

Fight through seven stages, from the first patrol to the Dawn Citadel, each ending in a boss battle. Clear the game without continuing and a harder second loop begins. Clear that on a single credit to face the true final form and reach the true ending.

Practice any stage or jump straight to any boss, then take what you learn back to a full run. Your best runs are saved for each user.

Play on the TV, in tabletop mode or in handheld mode, with buttons you can remap. In handheld mode you can also turn the console on its side and play vertically, with buttons or touch controls. Four color palettes include a color-blind-friendly option, and subtle HD Rumble can be switched off.

The soundtrack arranges classical music by Bach, Handel, Vivaldi, Mozart, Beethoven and Holst.

• Switch polarity to absorb bullets of your color and dodge the rest
• Fill the Flux gauge and unleash Break to clear the screen
• Seven stages and their bosses, plus a harder second loop and a true ending
• Practice mode for any stage or boss
• Remappable buttons, four color palettes and vertical handheld play with touch controls

Developed by Krazy Games.
